title: 2025 Mauricio Gomes Seminar
description_html:
Join us for an exclusive seminar hosted by Kingston Jiu Jitsu featuring the legendary Mauricio Gomes.

Known as one of the pioneers of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu, Mauricio brings a wealth of knowledge and experience to the mat. With a distinguished career spanning over six decades, Mauricio is currently an 8th-degree coral belt and the highest ranked jiu jitsu practitioner in Europe.

Seminar Details:

  • Date: December 6th, 2025
  • Time: 2.00 - 4.00 PM
  • Location: Tiffin Sports Centre, London Rd, Kingston upon Thames, KT2 6RL
  • Price: £30 for members, £40 for non-members

 

Don’t miss this chance to elevate your skills and gain insights from one of the most respected figures in Brazilian Jiu Jitsu. Secure your spot now and be part of an unforgettable experience!

 

About Mauricio

Mauricio began training in Jiu-Jitsu at just four years of age. His father, who was a brown belt, started his journey and took him to classes at João Alberto Barreto’s academy.

As a teenager, Mauricio began training with the legendary Rolls Gracie. Under Rolls' guidance, he became a highly successful competitor and won the absolute division of the Rio de Janeiro State Championships in 1981. Shortly after this victory Rolls would award Mauricio his black belt. Mauricio continued training with Rolls until his tragic death in 1982.

Through his close ties with the Gracie family, Mauricio met Reila Gracie, the daughter of Carlos Gracie Sr. The two married and, although their relationship didn't last, they had a son, Roger Gracie. Roger would go on to become a ten-time World Champion and is widely recognised as being the greatest Jiu-Jitsu competitor of all time.

In the late 1990s, Mauricio came to the UK and established the very first Gracie Barra gym there. Through his teaching, many new gyms would open and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu is now the fastest growing martial art in the UK.

title: 4-Week Women's Beginners Course
description_html:
Curious About Trying Jiu Jitsu?

Our 4-week Women’s Only Beginners Course is the perfect way to get started in a friendly, supportive environment.

No uniform needed. No experience required. Just bring comfortable gym clothes and an open mind.

You’ll learn the fundamentals of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu in a relaxed, women-only setting — ideal for complete beginners who want to build confidence, fitness, and practical self-defence skills.

 

Course details:

      📍 Tiffin Sports Centre, Kingston
      📅 Starts Tuesday, 6th January 2026
      🕖 Every Tuesday from 7–8 pm
      💰 Only £40 for the full 4 weeks

title: 6-Week Adult Beginners Course
description_html:
6-Week Adult Beginners Course

Starts Monday 7 September 2026
Mondays 6pm-7pm
Kingston Upon Thames

Looking for a fun way to get fit, learn practical self-defence and try something new?

Our 6-week Adult Beginners Course is the perfect introduction to Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ). No experience is required and every class is designed specifically for complete beginners.

Whether you're looking to improve your fitness, build confidence, learn self-defence or simply challenge yourself, our structured beginner programme will help you build a strong foundation in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in a friendly and supportive environment.

  • Free BJJ gi and white belt

This includes your free gi, free white belt and access to online lesson videos.

Reserve your place today and take the first step on your Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu journey.

title: 6-Week No-Gi Beginners Course
description_html:
Thinking About Giving No-Gi Jiu Jitsu a Go?

Our brand-new 6-week beginners course is a great way to ease into the world of No-Gi Brazilian Jiu Jitsu. Whether you're totally new to grappling, usually roll in the Gi but want to switch it up, or just want a solid reset on the fundamentals — this course is perfect for you. 

 

Course details:
📍 Tiffin Sports Centre, Kingston
📅 Starts Thursday, 1st May
🕗 Every Thursday from 8–9 pm
💰 Just £50 for the entire course!

 

What You’ll Learn:

  • No-Gi specific fundamentals of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu.

  • How to control and escape from key ground positions.

  • Distance management and takedowns suited to No-Gi.

  • Basic submissions and escapes.

  • Essential movement and strategy without relying on the Gi.

 

Why Join?

  • Tailored specifically for beginners and those new to No-Gi.

  • A structured and supportive environment to build your skills.

  • An excellent way to ease into our regular No-Gi classes.

 

LIMITED SPACES AVAILABLE


Don’t miss your chance to start (or restart) your No-Gi journey with us.

 

📩 Contact admin@kingstonjiujitsu.com to book your spot or ask any questions.

title: Kingston Jiu Jitsu × Mauricio Gomes Limited Edition Gi | Black
description_html:
A special collaboration celebrating the roots of Kingston Jiu Jitsu and the legacy of Professor Mauricio Gomes.

This limited edition gi features a custom inner lining with a striking sublimated artwork of Kingston Bridge at sunset. The illustration was created by artist Mark Stroud and captures one of the most recognisable landmarks in Kingston upon Thames. It reflects the place where our academy and community have grown.

The result is a gi that combines tradition, craftsmanship, and local identity.

 

Key features

  • Limited edition collaboration with Mauricio Gomes
  • Custom sublimated lining featuring Kingston Bridge artwork by Mark Stroud
  • Exclusive Kingston Jiu Jitsu design
  • Lightweight pearl weave jacket for durability and comfort
  • Reinforced stitching in all key stress areas
  • Competition-legal construction
  • Unique woven Kingston Jiu Jitsu detailing

 

Why this gi is special

Kingston Jiu Jitsu has always been about more than just training. It is about community, history, and connection to the place where we train.

The lining artwork celebrates Kingston Bridge and the River Thames, a scene familiar to anyone who has spent time in the town. It is a small but meaningful detail that makes this gi unmistakably ours.

Once these are gone, they will not be reproduced.

title: Kingston Jiu Jitsu Club Rashguard
description_html:
Represent Kingston Jiu Jitsu with our classic club rashguard!

Our rashguards are made from heavy-duty Lycra to protect your skin during no-gi training and competition.

  • Can also be used under your kimono as well to help protect your skin.
  • Allows moisture to pass through rather than soaking up like a t-shirt.
  • Cut long to make it easy to tuck in. Flat stitching to prevent irritation.
  • Wider cut neck for less restriction.
  • Sublimated logos and patterns so they will not peel off in the dryer or while training.
